page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.32xlarge is an enterprise-grade memory-optimized instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. The instance configuration provisions 128 dedicated vCPUs paired with 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:8 core-to-memory ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per virtual core.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring persistence to be provisioned via remote block storage volumes. It also operates without hardware GPU accelerators. Network connectivity is supported by a 36 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the instance provisions zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, expecting routing through assigned virtual private network infrastructure.

With its large memory footprint and high count of dedicated compute cores, ecs.r9i.32xlarge delivers significant resource density for memory-constrained architectures. This resource ratio makes the instance suited for large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, high-volume transactional databases, and extensive big data analytics.
